retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban aesthetic featuring a weathered street sign with a city skyline silhouette and distressed stencil typography.
excludeWhen: nature-focused landscapes are the primary subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical rectangular sign with rounded corners mounted on a textured wooden pole, divided into a white upper section with bold sans-serif text and a red lower section with distressed stencil lettering, featuring a black city skyline silhouette in the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Sign mounted centrally on a vertical wooden texture
Skyline silhouette acting as a horizontal divider
Text blocks balanced above and below the central graphic
High-contrast interplay between white, black, and deep red
coreInvariants: Two-tone color blocking (white top, red bottom)
Distressed/weathered texture on the lower text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sign is the primary subject, occupying the central 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black city skyline silhouette serves as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold header text, through the skyline, to the distressed footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-contrast white space in the upper sign area balances the busy textures of the wood and background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated, gritty tones in the background photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to white, black, and deep red for the sign
Sepia or desaturated tones for the photographic background

letterConstructionRules: Upper text: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with flat terminals
Lower text: Wide, blocky stencil construction with simulated paint erosion
Uniform stroke weight in the upper section
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stencil gaps in the lower text are irregular and weathered
Letters in the lower section show 'chipped' edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Clean, authoritative sans-serif paired with gritty, street-style stencil.

preserve: The contrast between clean and distressed text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top text
Provides the industrial stencil base for the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast urban scene with a wooden utility pole in the foreground. On the pole, place a blank white rectangular sign with rounded corners and a red bottom third. In the center of the sign, place a black silhouette of a city skyline.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold black condensed sans-serif text to the top white section. Apply white distressed stencil-style text to the bottom red section, ensuring the letters look weathered and eroded.

verificationChecks: Is the sign divided into white and red sections?
Is the bottom text significantly more distressed than the top text?
Is there a city skyline silhouette in the middle?

mustRedesign: Avoid using existing brand logos in the circular icon
Ensure the skyline is a generic silhouette
postGenerationChecks: Verify stencil gaps are visible in the lower text
Ensure the wooden pole texture is visible behind the sign
Confirm the skyline silhouette is solid black
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Signage = (High-Contrast Photography + Wooden Texture) + (Two-Tone Sign Base) + (Clean Sans-Serif Header / Distressed Stencil Footer) + (Central Graphic Silhouette)
